rule_description: Knitted jerseys from Vietnam eligible for UK-Vietnam preferential treatment if substantially transformed
required_documents: Certificate of origin; commercial invoice; bill of lading
eligibility_criteria: Goods must be substantially transformed in Vietnam with minimum 65% regional value content

rule_description: Other garments from Vietnam eligible under UK-Vietnam agreement with value threshold
required_documents: Certificate of origin; manufacturing statement; invoice
eligibility_criteria: Substantial transformation required with 70% regional value content threshold

rule_description: Knitted jersey from Indonesia qualifies under CPTPP agreement
required_documents: Certificate of origin; packing list; commercial invoice
eligibility_criteria: CPTPP Rules of Origin: Indonesia operations meet substantial transformation and 60% RVC requirements

rule_description: Women's skirts from Indonesia under CPTPP with lower RVC requirement
required_documents: CPTPP certificate of origin; bill of materials; invoice
eligibility_criteria: CPTPP-eligible manufacturing in Indonesia meets 55% regional value content and substantial transformation criteria

rule_description: Knitted apparel from Vietnam under GSP with simplified eligibility
required_documents: GSP certificate of origin; commercial documentation
eligibility_criteria: GSP-eligible goods with 50% minimum value content from originating country
